## Cooldown  (type-only)
interface Cooldown {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly duration: number;
    readonly ready: boolean;
    readonly remaining: number;
    readonly progress: number;
    use(): boolean;
    reset(): void;
}

## Emitter
class Emitter<M extends EventMap> {
    on<K extends keyof M>(type: K, fn: Listener<M[K]>): () => void;
    once<K extends keyof M>(type: K, fn: Listener<M[K]>): () => void;
    off<K extends keyof M>(type: K, fn: Listener<M[K]>): void;
    emit<K extends keyof M>(type: K, ...payload: M[K] extends void ? [] : [M[K]]): void;
    listenerCount(type: keyof M): number;
    clear(): void;
}

## EventMap  (type-only)
type EventMap = Record<string, any>;

## EveryOptions  (type-only)
interface EveryOptions {
    count?: number;
}

## FbmOptions  (type-only)
interface FbmOptions {
    octaves?: number;
    lacunarity?: number;
    gain?: number;
}

## FixedStepper
class FixedStepper {
    readonly step: number;
    readonly maxFrameDt: number;
    readonly maxSteps: number;
    accumulator: number;
    constructor(opts?: FixedStepperOptions);
    advance(frameDt: number): number;
    get alpha(): number;
    reset(): void;
}

## FixedStepperOptions  (type-only)
interface FixedStepperOptions {
    step?: number;
    maxFrameDt?: number;
    maxSteps?: number;
}

## GameLoop
class GameLoop {
    readonly time: Time;
    constructor(cb: LoopCallbacks, opts?: GameLoopOptions);
    get isRunning(): boolean;
    get paused(): boolean;
    set paused(v: boolean);
    get maxFps(): number | null;
    set maxFps(fps: number | null);
    get halted(): boolean;
    start(): void;
    stop(): void;
    setFrames(src: FrameSource): void;
    halt(): void;
    tickOnce(frameDt: number): void;
}

## GameLoopOptions  (type-only)
interface GameLoopOptions extends FixedStepperOptions {
    fixed?: boolean;
    now?: () => number;
    frames?: FrameSource;
}

## LoopCallbacks  (type-only)
interface LoopCallbacks {
    update(dt: number, time: Time): void;
    render(alpha: number, time: Time): void;
}

## Mat4  (type-only)
type Mat4 = Float32Array;

## Noise  (type-only)
interface Noise {
    value2(x: number, y: number): number;
    value3(x: number, y: number, z: number): number;
    perlin2(x: number, y: number): number;
    perlin3(x: number, y: number, z: number): number;
    simplex2(x: number, y: number): number;
    simplex3(x: number, y: number, z: number): number;
    fbm(fn: NoiseFn, x: number, y: number, z?: number, opts?: FbmOptions): number;
}

## NoiseFn  (type-only)
type NoiseFn = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => number;

## NumberSink  (type-only)
interface NumberSink {
    [index: number]: number;
}

## Pool  (type-only)
interface Pool<T> {
    readonly size: number;
    readonly live: number;
    acquire(): T | undefined;
    release(item: T): boolean;
    forEach(fn: (item: T, index: number) => void): void;
    drain(): void;
}

## PoolOptions  (type-only)
interface PoolOptions<T> {
    create: () => T;
    reset?: (item: T) => void;
    initial?: number;
    max?: number;
}

## Random  (type-only)
interface Random {
    readonly key: number;
    next(): number;
    int(min: number, max: number): number;
    float(min: number, max: number): number;
    bool(p?: number): boolean;
    pick<T>(array: ArrayLike<T>): T;
    weighted(weights: ArrayLike<number>): number;
    shuffle<T, A extends {
        [index: number]: T;
        length: number;
    }>(array: A): A;
    gaussian(mean?: number, sd?: number): number;
    unitVec2<T extends NumberSink>(out: T): T;
    unitVec3<T extends NumberSink>(out: T): T;
    fork(name: string): Random;
    state: Uint32Array;
}

## Scene  (type-only)
interface Scene<Ctx = unknown, Frame = unknown, Cam = Camera> {
    readonly name?: string;
    readonly transparent?: boolean;
    preload?(ctx: Ctx): Promise<void>;
    enter?(ctx: Ctx): void;
    exit?(): void;
    pause?(): void;
    resume?(): void;
    update?(dt: number): void;
    render?(frame: Frame, camera: Cam, alpha: number): void;
}

## SceneStack
class SceneStack<Ctx = unknown, Frame = unknown, Cam = Camera> {
    constructor(ctx: Ctx);
    get size(): number;
    get top(): Scene<Ctx, Frame, Cam> | undefined;
    get transitioning(): boolean;
    get scenes(): readonly Scene<Ctx, Frame, Cam>[];
    push(scene: Scene<Ctx, Frame, Cam>): Promise<void>;
    pop(): void;
    replace(scene: Scene<Ctx, Frame, Cam>): Promise<void>;
    clear(): void;
    onTransition(fn: TransitionListener<Ctx, Frame, Cam>): () => void;
    update(dt: number): void;
    render(frame: Frame, camera: Cam, alpha?: number): void;
}

## Scheduler  (type-only)
interface Scheduler {
    readonly time: number;
    readonly active: number;
    readonly paused: boolean;
    after(seconds: number, fn: () => void): TimerHandle;
    every(seconds: number, fn: () => void, opts?: EveryOptions): TimerHandle;
    cooldown(name: string, seconds: number): Cooldown;
    remaining(handle: TimerHandle): number;
    cancel(handle: TimerHandle): boolean;
    update(dt: number): void;
    clear(): void;
    pause(): void;
    resume(): void;
}

## Seed  (type-only)
type Seed = number | string;

## Time  (type-only)
interface Time {
    readonly step: number;
    simTime: number;
    realTime: number;
    frameDt: number;
    frame: number;
    tick: number;
}

## TimerHandle  (type-only)
type TimerHandle = number;

## TransitionListener  (type-only)
type TransitionListener<Ctx = unknown, Frame = unknown, Cam = Camera> = (from: Scene<Ctx, Frame, Cam> | undefined, to: Scene<Ctx, Frame, Cam> | undefined, phase: TransitionPhase) => void;

## TransitionPhase  (type-only)
type TransitionPhase = 'preload' | 'enter' | 'exit';
